entry.title: Hairspring 1.0.2 keeps repeatability evidence with each measurement
entry.summary: Hairspring 1.0.2 preserves completed rate-verification evidence in History and PDF receipts, makes amplitude ranges consistent, and improves position summaries.
entry.content:
Measure the same watch twice and Hairspring now keeps both rate readings, their fit uncertainties, the agreement limit, the verdict, and the analysis version with the saved measurement and its PDF receipt.

The update also makes amplitude ranges consistent across the app, keeps position summaries descriptive, and reports the installed version correctly.
